description: This file implements a Gemini web search provider plugin, including configuration resolution, API interaction, and search execution with caching and citation resolution.

methods.name: resolveGeminiConfig
methods.description: Resolves Gemini configuration from search config.

methods.name: resolveGeminiApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the Gemini API key from config or environment.

methods.name: resolveGeminiModel
methods.description: Resolves the Gemini model to use, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: runGeminiSearch
methods.description: Performs the Gemini search API call and processes the response.

methods.name: createGeminiSchema
methods.description: Creates the schema for Gemini search parameters.

methods.name: createGeminiToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates the web search tool definition for Gemini.

methods.name: createGeminiWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Exports the Gemini web search provider plugin.
